summary: Targeted regression test for deployment fix: root-level /health endpoint + resilient CORS parsing. All 6 acceptance criteria PASS. /health returns 200 {"status":"ok"} both on localhost:8001 and on the public URL. /api/ still returns API root JSON. /api/auth/me without cookies returns 401. Admin login (admin@dersim.app / Admin123!) returns 200 and sets httpOnly Secure access_token + refresh_token cookies; /api/auth/me with those cookies returns the admin user. Backend logs show 'GET /health HTTP/1.1 200 OK' (no more 404 loop). CORS _parse_origins() implementation verified: reads CORS_ORIGINS (comma-split), falls back to FRONTEND_URL, then '*' with allow_credentials disabled; allow_origin_regex supported via CORS_ORIGIN_REGEX. Only MONGO_URL, DB_NAME, JWT_SECRET are strictly required (os.environ[...]); CORS_ORIGINS/FRONTEND_URL are optional (safe fallback to '*').

minor.issue: Dead code: 'request.cookies.__dict__.setdefault("_dict", {})' does nothing meaningful; safe to remove.

critical_code_review_comments: CORS fix is correct — _parse_origins() properly handles missing FRONTEND_URL/CORS_ORIGINS and disables allow_credentials when using wildcard '*' (required by browsers).
/health is registered on `app` after include_router, so it lives at root path — matches k8s probe expectation.
Minor: middleware is added AFTER routes and startup handler; FastAPI/Starlette allow this but conventional order is add_middleware before include_router. Not a functional bug.
Login response includes admin name 'Yönetici' (not 'Admin' from seed) — indicates prior name update; not related to this fix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Deployment health-check fix and CORS resiliency are verified. /health lives at root (app-level), /api/* routes still work. No follow-up needed.
rca of the issue: Root cause: FastAPI had /api/health but k8s nginx probe was hitting /health at root -> 404 loop. Fix: added @app.get('/health') AFTER include_router at root path. CORS root cause: middleware read FRONTEND_URL directly which would 500 if unset. Fix: _parse_origins() with fallback chain CORS_ORIGINS -> FRONTEND_URL -> '*'.
